snippet.title: Rewilders: The Lost Spring - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Dive into the charming world of Rewilders: The Lost Spring in this new gameplay trailer, and learn more about the gameplay, traversal mechanics like the glider, dangers you'll face, characters, and story of the upcoming open-world roguelite game, featuring Metroidvania and creature-collecting elements. Rewilders: The Lost Spring will be available in Early Access on PC in 2026, with console launch plans further in the future. Additionally, sign-ups for Rewilder: The Lost Spring's first private playtest are available now on Steam. The playtest runs from November 12 to November 19, 2025.

In Rewilders: The Lost Spring, you will embody Abi, a survivor returning to the poisoned surface of the world to rescue her lost family and restore the wild. While exploring corrupted biomes—unlocking Hântu, finding lore, secrets, and enemies born from a failed society—she will come across her family and help restore them just as she will her environments, with the help of a mysterious being called Rif.
